text:
Nina: Tiny question for the room 1 what's the quirkiest 'just-in-case' thing in your desk/drawer?
Omar: A single mismatched contact lens case. No contacts but apparently hopeful.
Liz: A tin of mints that says "do not eat" because someone wrote that on it as a joke.
ben: A laminated emergency meme. For morale during long deploys.
kudos-bot: kudos-bot: Remember to appreciate teammates. Also, emergency meme accepted. :sparkles:
Nina: @ben please share the meme. We need morale boosters.
ben: *posts link to imgur* "When you fix the bug at 3am and nobody knows" with a triumphant raccoon.
Omar: I keep an old parking ticket from 2014. It's a nice reminder to park better.
Liz: Vote time: contact lens case, mints labeled "do not eat", laminated meme, or parking ticket? React :one:/:two:/:three:/:four:.
Nina: :three: laminated meme
Omar: :one: contact lens case (mystery wins)
ben: :three: meme, obviously
Liz: Results: meme and mystery case neck-and-neck.
Nina: Thanks team 1 this is the content my brain needed between meetings. I will not be returning the laminated meme to HR.
Omar: Also, pro tip: label your things or they become company folklore.
ben: New onboarding task: bring a quirky "just-in-case" item for team shelf. :sunglasses:
